title.narrative: Public Engagement & Strengthening Knowledge on Inclusive Digital Transformation

description.narrative: One main action will be developed to support implementation of this activity. Specifically, action will developed to launch a public reflection series on the impact of digital technologies broadly, and in particular, AI, exploring diverse ethical dilemmas ranging from the corporatization of these digital tools, further widening inequalities within and between countries, ethical dilemmas posed by these technologies on education systems, where emerging evidence is beginning to suggest that the increasing reliance on AI and other digital technologies is impacting on the capacity of young learner to think critically, and possibly partly responsible for increasing mental health among today's youth in society.
